TextBlock.Text: THE TASMAN APPROACHES, morning. The protection group is fifty miles north-east of you, transiting at fourteen knots: LIAONING, a frigate, a corvette, a replenishment ship, the research trawler NAN HAI 27 and the Russian research vessel, all in company, all going the same way. The fishing fleet it came to protect has been left to fish. You have what came out of the south, WEDGETAIL 05 out of East Sale, and for the first time since October a fighter that can reach the water you are in. Coastal traffic and the Melbourne-Auckland service are in the same box. Shadow the group. Classify the carrier, the replenishment ship and the collector. Hold the shadowing line behind them. Everything red is weapons tight and so are you: nobody in this box fires first, and the day that changes it will be in the Tasman, not here.

The group is going north into the Tasman and it is not going home. Shadow it out of the south and put a class and a name on every hull in the network - the carrier, the replenishment ship, the collector - so that Sydney and Wellington know what is coming before it arrives. Fire on nothing. East Sale's fighters reach this water for the first time since October; they are cover, not a strike. Hold the shadowing line and come home to Hobart.

Network: Classify the carrier, the replenishment ship and the collector Shadow: Then hold the shadowing line behind the group Restraint: Fire on nothing: shadow, do not start the Tasman war Wedgetail: Keep the Wedgetail flying Flagship: Bring your flagship out intact Neutrals: Harm no merchant, trawler or aircraft

Your task group with its Seahawk, Poseidon and fighters if bought, Wedgetail 05, all out of East Sale. Neutral: a coastal bulker, a trawler, an airliner. Opposing, transiting north-east: Liaoning, a Type 054A, a Type 056A, a replenishment ship, the research trawler Nan Hai 27, the Russian research vessel, a Ka-31 up.
70 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.
Destroying a neutral contact ends the operation in failure. Identify before you shoot.
MH-60R Seahawk, Boeing P-8 Poseidon, E-7A Wedgetail, PLAN Type 001 Aircraft Carrier Liaoning, Modern PLAN Systems, Civil Aircraft Mod (Airbus Family), the base game, this pack.
